 authorized work permit

Always use approved
 fall arrest equipment and procedures.

Always use approved
 temporary earthing equipment and procedures

Use personal
 protective equipment.

Maintain limits of
 approach from all circuits that have not been de-energized

Ensure that the
 insulators, hardware and conductor in the span to be worked on are in
 satisfactory mechanical condition to safely support the extra weight of the
 conductor trolley and line man.

Inspect the cart
 and correct any defects.
Hand Line
Double conductor trolley

Earthing cable and
 climbing tools

Pulling rope about
 20 meter (L.L.RO)
Rope Ladder
Fall protection equipment
New spacer

Visually check the
 insulators in the work location from the Ground.

Check the wheels of
 the trolley. See Fig.1

Two linemen must climb
 the tower and detect the volt using voltage detector.

Temporary earthing
 cables must be installed on both sides of the work area.

Install the hand line
 on the tower cross arm above the work level to make it easy to install the
 equipment.

Raise the ladder and
 install it to the cross arm above the work area.

Raise the trolley to
 the level of the phase in which the work will be done.

One lineman descends
 on the ladder and the another lineman stands at the end of the cross arm and
 helps the other lineman to install the trolley on the conductor.

Raise the pulling rope
 to the lineman on the rope ladder to attach one end to the trolley while the
 other end Remain on the ground to use it as pulling rope.

Raise the new spacer
 to the lineman on the ladder.

The lineman on the
 ladder moves from the ladder to the trolley using his safety rope the
 lineman attach his pole strap to the trolley then release his fall arrest.

By using pulling rope
 pull the trolley to the defected spacer location on the conductor and use
 the brake of the trolley to stop the trolley. See Fig. 2

The lineman on the
 trolley can exchange the defect spacer by the new spacer.

When he finished the
 work the trolley must be go back to the initial suspension point.

Lower the trolley and
 tools to the ground.

Remove the ground
 cables from the conductor.
Complete and finish the work permit.

Transmission Lines | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This procedure outlines
the steps required to use trolley on double conductor over head transmission
line to do some maintenance on the conductor.
Safety Precautions
Obtain an
 authorized work permit
Always use approved
 fall arrest equipment and procedures.
Always use approved
 temporary earthing equipment and procedures
Use personal
 protective equipment.
Maintain limits of
 approach from all circuits that have not been de-energized
Ensure that the
 insulators, hardware and conductor in the span to be worked on are in
 satisfactory mechanical condition to safely support the extra weight of the
 conductor trolley and line man.
Inspect the cart
 and correct any defects.
Tools and Equipment
Hand Line
Double conductor trolley
Earthing cable and
 climbing tools
Pulling rope about
 20 meter (L.L.RO)
Rope Ladder
Fall protection equipment
New spacer
Work to be Carried Out
Visually check the
 insulators in the work location from the Ground.
Check the wheels of
 the trolley. See Fig.1
Two linemen must climb
 the tower and detect the volt using voltage detector.
Temporary earthing
 cables must be installed on both sides of the work area.
Install the hand line
 on the tower cross arm above the work level to make it easy to install the
 equipment.
Raise the ladder and
 install it to the cross arm above the work area.
Raise the trolley to
 the level of the phase in which the work will be done.
One lineman descends
 on the ladder and the another lineman stands at the end of the cross arm and
 helps the other lineman to install the trolley on the conductor.
Raise the pulling rope
 to the lineman on the rope ladder to attach one end to the trolley while the
 other end Remain on the ground to use it as pulling rope.
Raise the new spacer
 to the lineman on the ladder.
The lineman on the
 ladder moves from the ladder to the trolley using his safety rope the
 lineman attach his pole strap to the trolley then release his fall arrest.
By using pulling rope
 pull the trolley to the defected spacer location on the conductor and use
 the brake of the trolley to stop the trolley. See Fig. 2
The lineman on the
 trolley can exchange the defect spacer by the new spacer.
When he finished the
 work the trolley must be go back to the initial suspension point.
Lower the trolley and
 tools to the ground.
Remove the ground
 cables from the conductor.
Complete and finish the work permit.
